verdict.rationale: The evidence implies Factory connects to repositories: Droid analyzes pull and merge requests and posts inline comments, automations run "across your repos," and Software Factory tracks repository coverage. Nothing in the pack describes how access is granted or whether it is a simple one-click install. missing for 10: documented one-click repo/app install flow (e.g., GitHub/GitLab app authorization), evidence that setup requires no complex configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding ease.
